carpet.rule.fakePlayerPersistence.name: Fake Player Persistence
carpet.rule.fakePlayerPersistence.desc: Automatically summon recorded fake players after server restart.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerActionSaving.name: Fake Player Action Saving
carpet.rule.fakePlayerActionSaving.desc: Record fake players' ongoing actions every 30 seconds (requires Fake Player Persistence).
carpet.rule.fakePlayerPrefix.name: Fake Player Prefix
carpet.rule.fakePlayerPrefix.desc: Add a unified prefix to fake players in the tab list.
carpet.rule.entityOptimizationEnabled.de: Optimize rendering for many identical entities at the same position to improve FPS. Details in entity_optimization.json.
carpet.rule.pearlCannonEnabled.name: Pearl Cannon Encoder
carpet.rule.pearlCannonEnabled.desc: Enable /eun pearlCannon command for binary encoding calculations.
carpet.rule.globalScoreboardEnabled.name: Global Scoreboard
carpet.rule.globalScoreboardEnabled.desc: Display player statistics rankings on the scoreboard.
carpet.rule.highlightEnabled.name: Personal Highlight
carpet.rule.highlightEnabled.desc: Enable /eun highlight command to highlight items or mobs around a player.
carpet.rule.aiOptimizationEnabled.name: Collision-less Stacked Entity AI Optimization
carpet.rule.aiOptimizationEnabled.desc: Skip AI for stacked entities in collision-free environments (e.g. scaffolding/vines) to reduce MSPT. Details in ai_optimization.json.
carpet.rule.craftableInvisibleItemFrames: Craft 8 invisible item frames using 8 item frames + 1 amethyst shard.
carpet.rule.autoTotemEquip.name: Auto Totem Equip
carpet.rule.autoTotemEquip.desc: Automatically equip a Totem of Undying from inventory/containers when about to die.
carpet.rule.suppressMagmaCubeInNetherWas: Suppress Magma Cube Spawns in Nether Wastes
Prevent magma cubes from spawning naturally in Nether Wastes (spawner spawns remain).
carpet.rule.packetEnabled.name: Fake Player Auto-Packing
carpet.rule.packetEnabled.desc: Enable /eun packet command to configure auto-packing for fake players.
